_help: Public roadmap at /roadmap. Edit this file to add or move an item; no code change needed. status: planned | in_progress | released. product: cli | console | both. release (optional): version whose notes describe it.

items.title: AtGlance agent for Linux, Windows Server and macOS
items.summary: A small agent that keeps one outbound, encrypted connection to your console. No open ports. Runs as a systemd service, a Windows service or a launchd job.

items.title: Agent Monitoring
items.summary: Live health, heartbeats and service state from every agent in the console, with one switch to turn monitoring on or off per workspace.

items.title: Remote Tunnel: Sites, relay and multi-site networking
items.summary: Reach servers on private networks through a connector, a relay, site-to-site IPsec or point-to-site access, with hops between sites.

items.title: Google Drive backup storage
items.summary: Keep console backups (database and configuration files) in your own Google Drive and restore from them. Free, part of Backup & Restore.

items.title: Production web server in the console image
items.summary: Replace the PHP development server inside the console image with a production web server.

items.title: Cloud-native access for Remote Tunnel
items.summary: Reach servers in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud through the provider's own access service. No connector, no IPsec, no inbound port.

items.title: One-click console deploy to AWS and Azure
items.summary: Deploy the Management Console into your own cloud account from the AtGlance dashboard.

items.title: CLI as a cloud VM extension (AWS EC2, Azure VM)
items.summary: Install and register the CLI on new cloud VMs as a VM extension.

items.title: Application and system services shown separately
items.summary: status, watch and export split services into what the host runs and the operating system's own, with --type to show one kind.

items.title: Daily check and sync with a service account
items.summary: schedule enable writes a cron job that checks keys and backs up changed services every day, with a service account key.

items.title: Patched runtime and request limits (PHP2Shell fix)
items.summary: The console runs PHP 8.2.35, refuses request bodies over 12 MB at the edge and no longer exposes the PHP server.

items.title: NFS and Azure Storage targets, encrypted backups
items.summary: Store backups on NFS or Azure Storage, with a manifest, checksums and client-side encryption.
